system.description: Mounted, first entering combat, previous failed check, or facing significant new threat. Must spend action if failed previous check. Difficulty is Fear/Terror rating (if higher). Normally to end of Act or next Rally unless GM warrants a new Control check. Above, plus add [Dc] to next action or [Dm] to this encounter’s Ride checks. Lose AND action fighting to keep horse from fleeing. If Fear/Terror mount loses 1 Wind. You may also dismount or flee.
